notes: The first five minutes are good, and close to what the band asked for. The public screen shows nothing personal and has one obvious next step (Connect wallet), plus a demo path. After connecting there is one big 'Create your first tour' button. The wizard asks exactly the four questions (draw 100–5,000, price, start city, length), has sensible defaults and big tappable choices, and shows the route (map, days, drives, venue cut) before 'Book this tour'. Activity is grouped into collapsible categories with counts and the latest line. Things fall apart the moment the band 'lets it run'. After booking, the dashboard reads the tour back from chain with a broken day mapping (shows planned on consecutive days come back as Day 1, Day 91, Day 181…). It labels the band's own tour 'auto-pilot approves' and 'Recorded run… decisions are off here', and the stepper shows Offers/Venues OK/Route OK as not done. The 'Activity on-chain' feed is program-wide, not this band's. The Activity page, Venues ('on your tour', 'offered … tickets', '(home)') and Planner ('Load my tour') all show the bundled demo run's band, so a connected band, and even a visitor with no wallet, sees someone else's tour labelled 'your'. The landing page and Approvals promise 'miss the threshold and you pick a replacement', but the keeper that runs wallet-booked tours never offers one, so a cancelled date is a dead end. Money is asked in euros and then shown everywhere in SOL. Chain words remain (on-chain, escrow, rent, threshold, vault, crank, settle_show, tx ↗). Nothing before booking shows what the band earns or that half the tickets must sell. On phones the nav hides Band record and Activity off-screen with no hint, and Venues renders as a 15,000 px page with every city expanded. Returning users see the connect screen flash before autoConnect. The UI bot's checks pass because they stop at the route preview and never look at the tour after it is booked.
issues: packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:80 (with lib/book.ts:127-128): a wallet-booked tour's shows are 180 s apart on-chain and `day = round((date - firstDate)/2)` turns them into Day 1, 91, 181… with '89 days off' legs and 'N shows in 541 days' on the dashboard itinerary, so the route the band approved is not the route it sees. Fix: store the planned day (e.g. in the tour name/memo or a localStorage map keyed by show address written in bookTour) and use it, or derive day as the show's index in the planner's day list, never from compressed timestamps.

packages/web/src/app/feed/page.tsx:181 + components/Feed.tsx:67 and app/page.tsx:357-358: the Activity page shows the bundled demo run's transcript ('Your decisions 8: Auto-pilot picked a replacement for Nuremberg', fan names) to every visitor, connected or not, and the dashboard's 'Activity on-chain' is fetchChainEvents over the whole program, i.e. other bands' tickets and payouts. Fix: filter both by the session's tour/show addresses (fetchLiveTour already has them; use getSignaturesForAddress on the tour/show accounts), gate /feed like the other band pages, and label demo data 'Demo band' instead of 'Your …'.

packages/web/src/app/approvals/page.tsx:222-224 and components/Connect.tsx:139 (keeper: packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:1-8): the band is promised 'Miss the threshold and you pick a replacement' and 'the replacement options show up here', but wallet-booked tours are run by the keeper, which only cancels and refunds, so a cancelled show leads nowhere (dashboard page.tsx:178 just says 'every fan was refunded', with no action). Fix: have the dashboard compute replacement options client-side with alternatives.ts for a cancelled show and offer 'Book a replacement' (one wallet signature), or remove the promise from both screens.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:231-233, 265-269, 188-195: on the band's own live tour the header says 'Central Europe tour · auto-pilot approves' (run.approvals is undefined for live tours), static hosting adds 'Recorded run… decisions are off here', and the stepper shows Offers/Venues OK/Route OK as '–'/not done although the band approved the route in the wizard. Fix: for live tours (cluster === 'live') say 'you approved the route', hide the recorded-run note, and collapse the stepper to Booked → On sale → Confirmed → Paid.

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:50-51,130,192-193 and app/planner/page.tsx:104-111,219-222: Venues and Planner take 'your tour', 'offered N tickets', '(home)' and 'Load my tour' from getRun() (the demo band), not the connected wallet. A visitor with no wallet sees another band's home city and 'on your tour' badges, and a connected band loads someone else's route. Fix: derive these from useBandSession().authority via fetchLiveTour, and hide them when no wallet is connected.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:158-199: the preview shows the route but not the result that matters to a band, which is money and risk. Nothing says each show needs half its tickets sold by the deadline or it is cancelled and refunded (that appears only after booking, at line 75), and there is no 'your share if it sells out / at break-even' (the Approvals route card at components/Approvals.tsx:311-317 has it). Fix: add a three-number summary above 'Book this tour': tickets to sell per show to go ahead, your take at that point and at sell-out (in €), and the one-line refund promise.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:195-197, app/page.tsx:302-304, components/ShowCard.tsx:43, app/show/page.tsx:123-124,174-180,215, app/band/page.tsx:98, components/Connect.tsx:197-198: the band answers in euros and is then shown SOL everywhere ('In escrow 0.03 SOL', '0.0003 SOL of play money'), plus 'on-chain', 'rent', 'escrow', 'threshold', 'vault ↗', 'Anyone can run the crank', 'settle_show', 'tx ↗'. Fix: display € via LAMPORTS_PER_EURO everywhere money appears, keep SOL in a secondary 'details' disclosure, and rename terms in the UI: escrow to 'held until the show', threshold to 'needed to go ahead', settle to 'paid out'; drop the vault and crank links.

packages/web/src/app/planner/page.tsx:252-258 (whole page): the Route planner is a dead end. A band can sketch a route but there is no 'Book this route' or 'Use as my tour' step, and the wizard ignores the plan, so the work goes nowhere ('Saved in this browser only'). Fix: add a primary 'Create a tour from this route' that opens /tour/new pre-seeded with the stops, or move the planner under a secondary 'Tools' heading so it does not compete with the wizard.

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:1071-1079: at 390 px the nav is a horizontal scroller that cuts off at 'Route plann', and Band record and Activity are invisible with no scroll hint (phone-*.png). The gated phone pages also show the 'Greenroom' brand twice. Fix: a fixed bottom tab bar with 4 items (Home, Approvals, Venues, Activity; the planner and band record live under Home), or wrap the nav with a fade/chevron affordance; hide the .welcome .brand on phones.

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:152-206: Venues is not compact. On a phone it renders as one 15,315 px page with all 136 venues expanded, each with a full-width '+ PLAN' pill, under five filter controls. Fix: render each city as a collapsed <details> row (city, drive, venue count, capacity range) that opens on tap, collapse the filters into a single 'Filter' button on small screens, and make '+ Plan' an icon button.

packages/web/src/components/Shell.tsx:46 (with Providers.tsx WalletProvider autoConnect): gating uses session.wallet, which is null until autoConnect finishes, so a returning band gets a flash of the public 'Connect wallet' screen on every load. On slow networks this is several seconds and looks like a logout. Fix: track wallet `connecting`/autoConnect state and render a neutral skeleton (sidebar plus empty header) until it settles, and show the connect screen only when no remembered wallet exists.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:246-249 + lib/chain-live.ts:64 + app/tour/new/page.tsx:69-87: 'New tour' is always offered and the dashboard shows only the latest tour (toursCreated - 1), so booking a second tour silently hides a tour still selling. The 'Your tour is booked' confirmation is also lost on reload, and refreshing /tour/new offers to book again. Fix: when a tour is live, show 'Your tour is running' with a link back instead of the wizard, and list past/active tours on the dashboard.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:96-97 + components/WalletPanel.tsx:417-461: the first thing on the connected home screen is a chain strip (wallet address, '1.5 SOL devnet', 'Settled shows', 'Tickets you hold'), and the copy says 'Your band is on-chain'. A musician's home should lead with the band and the next step. Fix: move the wallet strip into the wallet button's menu or a collapsed 'Wallet' disclosure, and change line 401 to 'You're set up. Time for the first tour.'

packages/web/src/components/Connect.tsx:154-155 and app/tour/new/page.tsx:19: band registration pre-fills a specific band name ('The Running Pigeons') for every new wallet, and the wizard always starts in Berlin, whatever the band. Fix: start the name field empty with a placeholder, ask the home city at registration (or remember the last start city), and default the start city to it.

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:154 vs app/tour/new/page.tsx:196: the fine print says 'Your wallet asks you once', but a tour longer than about 6 shows packs into several transactions, and a failure halfway (book.ts:164) leaves a half-created tour with a raw JSON error; pressing Book again opens another tour. Fix: say 'Your wallet asks you to approve N transactions', and on partial failure resume proposing into the existing tour instead of creating a new one, with a plain-language error.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:48-50: if no venue profile is on-chain yet, or the RPC rate-limits, the band is told 'No venue can take a band of this size… try a different size' or shown a raw RPC message. That is wrong advice, and the dead end says nothing about what to do. Fix: tell 'venues not ready yet' apart from 'no venue fits' and from 'network busy', and give each a matching next step (wait and retry automatically, change size, or retry).

packages/web/src/app/band/page.tsx:53-61,73-106: for a new band the Band record is five zeros, a 'settle_show' explanation and no next step. The non-wallet fallback says 'Run the demo first' or 'Is the validator running?', which is developer text. Fix: an empty state ('No shows played yet. Your record grows with every paid-out show.') with a 'Create a tour' button, and plain error copy.

phone-planner.png (packages/web/src/app/planner/page.tsx with globals.css .sidebar at 896px): at phone width the planner renders an empty ~140 px band between the nav and the page. Also, 'Clear' (planner/page.tsx:230) wipes the whole plan with no undo. Fix: find the element stretching the header row on this page (likely the map or sticky element) and give 'Clear' an undo toast.

packages/web/src/components/Approvals.tsx:346-357 vs app/tour/new/page.tsx:187-194: the same decision, approving a route, works differently in two places. Approvals has 'Approve route and book' with per-stop keep checkboxes and a 'Decline' button. The wizard has 'Book this tour' and 'Change answers', and stops cannot be dropped. Approvals.tsx:390 also counts down in raw seconds ('lapses in about 287s'). Fix: share one RouteReview component with the same buttons and stop toggles, and show countdowns as 'about 5 min'.
